Requirements Farum is not charged.

Trigger Another creature within 30 feet Casts a Spell or uses an action, activity, or reaction with the arcane, divine, magical, occult, or primal trait

You inscribe the runeword Farum on your person, turning your body into a nexus that holds magic. When you use this reaction, you invoke its command, causing you absorb a portion of the magic to empower the rune. Your Farum rune becomes charged. It remains charged for up to 1 minute before the magic fades. While it is charged, you gain a +1 status bonus to saving throws against effects with the arcane, divine, magical, occult and primal traits. This bonus becomes +2 at 15th level.
